title: Hear one rendered note as numbers
goal: Turn a single rendered note into pitch, envelope and brightness evidence a text-only agent can act on.
live_equivalent: Replace the fixture with the path returned by falcon_native_render (example 07).

steps.why: Tell the tool which note was played and when it was released, otherwise tuning and release cannot be judged.

conclusion: The note is about 12 cents sharp with a fast attack and a held sustain. Fix tuning (e.g. a fine-tune of -12 cents) before judging timbre. Report the number, never 'it sounds in tune'.
